```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}

lfix = LETTERS[LETTERS!="O"]

n1 = sample(6:9,1)
w1 = sample(lfix,n1,T)
lr = sample(lfix,1)
nrep = sample(2:3,1)
px = sample(1:n1,nrep)
w1[px] = rep(lr,nrep)

W1 = paste0(w1,collapse="")

while(T){
  lets = sample(lfix,2)
  repstr = paste0(lets,collapse="")
  if(!(lr %in% lets)){break}
}


W2 = gsub(lr,repstr,W1)


```

Question
========

Consider the string of characters shown below:

``r W1``

What new string would be created if every instance of ``r lr`` was replaced with ``r repstr``?

(Please use all uppercase letters and NO spaces.)


Solution
========

Here is the answer:

`r W2`

Notice, every ``r lr`` is now ``r repstr``.
